Name: Wildflour's Atelier Goods Cometkins Style
Author: Chocoronron
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8][size=5]Description[/size][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]This mod is highly configurable, as you can toggle almost every item type in WAG. You don't need to toggle off WAG items that are not part of your original WAG mod settings. This means that if you have Baker off, you don't need to toggle off the Baker item retextures for my mod to work.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Note: Some config options will toggle multiple different items, as they are either versions of the same product (i.e kombucha, ale, etc.) or they have shared visual elements (i.e breads in baskets). If you have custom retexture icons/pngs that conflict with this mod, you might need to be more hands-on and edit the object.png file directly.[/color]

If you use Forager's Nooks and Crannies, the forage bushes for the cherry blossom petals, wild berries, and tea leaves will be retextured as well. Even if you don't have it installed, the mod should work as normal.

This mod has not been tested thoroughly yet, so please report any errors you find. Thank you for reading. God bless and have a blessed day!

[size=5]Permissions[/size]
[size=3]Feel free to make translations of this mod whenever you'd like. You don't have to ask me for my permission.[/size]

[size=3]You can also reuse the icons found in the Objects.png file for any other SDV mods as long as you credit me and Cometkins for the original inspiration. However, you [b]cannot[/b] use any other sprites in this mod's asset files as they are simply recolors of existing WAG assets and are not my original art nor Cometkins's original art. [/size]

[size=3]Make sure to credit the original mod author (and artists if you're making a retexture mod) this mod is based on. They are listed in the credits section listed below.[/size]
